Ordering locally

Backyard celebrations, larger cakes and a semi rural edge.

  • The party is usually at the house.Home celebrations are the norm here, which means no commercial fridge and no back of house. Ask where the cake should sit on arrival, whether it needs time out of the fridge, and who will move it to the table.
  • Guest numbers push the size up.Larger homes mean larger gatherings, and the serving count is what sets the tin sizes and the number of tiers. Give the maker a real number early rather than adjusting it after the design is agreed.
  • Inland heat, not coastal heat.The Hills sit well back from the water and summer afternoons are hot and dry. Outdoor and marquee setups need a firmer covering, shade, and delivery as late as the schedule allows.
  • The rural fringe adds travel.Addresses out through Glenhaven, Dural, Annangrove and Glenorie sit on larger blocks and longer driveways. Mention it, because it changes the delivery time and sometimes the fee.

Common questions

Ordering a cake in Castle Hill

What size cake do I need for a large family party?

Work from servings rather than tiers. Count the adults you actually expect, tell the maker that number, and let them choose the tins and the tiers to reach it. The national cake size and serving guide sets out what each round and square tin yields so you can sanity check the answer.

We are setting up a marquee in the backyard. What should the maker know?

That it is outdoors, roughly what time the cake will be cut, and whether there is shade and power. A marquee in a Hills summer gets hot quickly. Expect advice to hold the cake inside until shortly before it is served and to choose a covering that will not soften on the table.

Will a maker deliver out to Dural or Glenorie?

Many will, but the distance and the driveway both matter. Give the full address and mention if it is a rural block or a long unsealed drive, because a tiered cake travels badly on gravel. Ask whether the delivery fee changes past a certain distance so there is no surprise later.
